merge.why: USER RULING 2026-10-25, accepting discovery's merge: 'Ancient Den merging with Plains is not entirely correct, but may be good enough. (it's primary use is a land, the Metalcraft is less crucial in this deck, though it is possible for it to come up)'. Accepted as an approximation, NOT as a statement that the two are the same card: Ancient Den is an artifact and counts toward metalcraft, Plains does not. Revisit first if a list change makes metalcraft load-bearing.
